provenance.source: PR #4171 fix(middleware/etag): should return 304 when weak etag is passed in 'If-None-Match', squash-merged 2025-05-29
provenance.note: the If-None-Match list is split on a comma plus the whitespace after it, so a tag written with whitespace before the comma keeps a trailing space and never equals the response's tag: a matching conditional request is answered 200 with the full body instead of 304; the base split the header the same way and this PR rewrote the comparison to add weak-tag handling without trimming the entries (fix PR #5222)

bugs.note: RFC 9110's #entity-tag list allows optional whitespace on both sides of a comma; splitting on /,\s*/ consumes only the right-hand side of each comma, so the left-hand entry keeps its trailing spaces and the equality test fails; the fix splits on the comma and trims each entry
